newsitem.title: MEXICO: REASEARCH ALERT - FEMSA, Bevides, Comerci at buy.
newsitem.headline: REASEARCH ALERT - FEMSA, Bevides, Comerci at buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Monday it has initiated coverage of three Mexican firms -- FEMSA, Bevides and Comerci -- each with a buy rating.
Caspian analyst Pablo Ruiz said bottler FEMSA, Mexico's largest Coca-Cola bottler and second-largest brewer, was attractive at a price of 23.10 pesos.
"We believe FEMSA's shares are attractively valued and that the company is well-positioned to benefit from a recovery in consumer demand," Ruiz wrote in an analysis.

Bevides, also known as Far-Ben, the largest pharmaceutical distributor in Mexico, also stands to benefit from expected increases in consumer income, Caspian analysts Esteban Galindez and Veatriz de Caceres said.

"As the Mexican economy improves, we expect the company to grow at a steady pace," their report said. "Despite an 88.8 percent year-to-date U.S. dollar increase, Bevides's shares are trading at large discounts to our sample of Mexican retailers."
As for Comerci, Mexico's third-largest supermarket chain, the same two analysts were encouraged by the company's expansion plans.

"After more than one year of consolidation, we expect Comerci's growth profile to improve after the completion of its planned equity offering," Caspian's analysis said. "Despite a 52.6 percent year-to-date dollar increase, Comerci's shares are trading at a discount to its three largest competitors."
